rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent stacked-shifted platform mass with a clear dominant ribbon-like gesture in all views. Main/support hierarchy is legible, with one primary elongated volume and smaller sectional shifts rather than random fragments. It does rely somewhat on terrace/stepback logic, so the silhouette is partly stair-like, but not exclusively so. The void logic is present only as a thin central slot/relief, not a strongly public courtyard or undercut. Volumes appear cleanly resolved with no obvious collisions or clipped geometry, making the form likely repairable. Precedent resonance is strong with OMA/BIG-style sectional stacking and terrace-ribbon principles, while still remaining its own massing.
warnings: Void is weakly articulated and reads more as a seam than a public spatial carve-out.
The massing leans on terraced stepbacks, so the silhouette risks becoming overly sectional if further fragmented.
